scientific_limitations: One dev-selected warmup seed201; update-seed intervals do not cover warmup variation.
Positive mean is the user-requested admission criterion, not a statistical-significance claim.
Previously used legacy test sets and reused supplementary confirmation data make this exploratory evidence.
Seven unreplicated oracle candidates are single-seed outcomes. No final-result-driven retuning was performed.
Predictor benefit does not by itself establish efficiency or superiority to true-gradient controls.
publication_scope: Compact results and configurations; original datasets, raw generations, weights, offline caches, and machine-specific orchestration are not included.
